items.title: Leicester hold nerve to knock out sixth-tier Oxford City
items.description: League One side, and 2021 champions, Leicester City avoid an upset as they beat sixth-tier Oxford City 4-2 at the MGroup Stadium, to reach the second round of the FA Cup.

items.title: Bristol Rovers shock Cambridge United to reach round two
items.description: League Two side Bristol Rovers end a run of six matches without a win, as they shock League One side Cambridge United, beating them 2-0 at the Memorial Stadium, to reach the second round of the FA Cup.

items.title: Lampard feels hair pull should have led to Coventry penalty
items.description: Coventry had a trio of decisions go against them in defeat at Everton, with Frank Lampard suggesting a hair pull should have been a penalty.

items.title: Lampard: VAR didn't do its job
items.description: Coventry boss Frank Lampard says VAR 'didn't do its job' in his side's defeat to Everton as three reviews controversially went against his side.

items.title: 'Big decisions' affected the game - Lampard
items.description: Coventry City head coach Frank Lampard is frustrated after three "big decisions" went against his side in their 3-1 defeat by Everton at the Hill Dickinson Stadium.

items.title: Not a good performance, but we got a result - Moyes
items.description: Everton manager David Moyes is pleased with his side's reaction to turn around a one goal deficit to win 3-1 against Coventry, but isn't pleased with their overall performance.

items.title: Barry scores twice as Everton fight back to beat Coventry
items.description: In-form Thierno Barry scores twice as Everton came from behind to beat Coventry as the Toffees move into fifth in the Premier League table.

items.title: Papers: Man Utd handed boost in pursuit of Barcelona left-back Alejandro Balde
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Saturday's newspapers...

items.title: Raith Rovers go top with Dunfermline draw
items.description: Watch highlights as Raith Rovers take over at the top of the Scottish Championship from Partick Thistle on goal difference, with visitors Dunfermline Athletic third on the same points as the Fife derby ends goalless.

items.title: Barry shines with four-minute double as Everton come back to beat Coventry
items.description: FREE TO WATCH: Highlights from Everton’s match against Coventry in the Premier League.

items.title: Barry leads Everton comeback win vs Coventry - who suffer triple VAR woe
items.description: Thierno Barry continued his fine form as his two goals and an assist fired Everton to a comeback 3-1 win over Coventry - who had three big VAR calls go against them on Merseyside.
